item.title: Logistics Distribution 101: What Exactly Is Distribution Logistics?
item.description: In today's fast-moving world of e-commerce, retail, and global trade, products rarely go straight from factory to shopper. Something crucial happens in between: distribution logistics. Also called outbound logistics or sales logistics, this is the part of the supply chain that bridges production and the end customer. Simply put, distribution logistics handles everything needed to move finished goods from warehouses or distribution centers to retailers, businesses, or directly to consumers as quickly, accurately, and cost-effectively as possible.

item.title: Naivasha depot operationalised to decongest Port of Mombasa
item.description: The government has activated the Naivasha Inland Container Depot as a key clearance hub for transit cargo to ease congestion at the Port of Mombasa. South Sudan, Uganda, Rwanda, and the DRC are set to begin operations at the facility as cargo volumes at Mombasa continue to rise.

item.title: South Sudan imports affected as Kenyan clearing agents halt services over fees
item.description: Trade Crisis at Mombasa Port: Kenyan clearing agents have indefinitely suspended services for all cargo destined for South Sudan. The boycott is a protest against a sudden $3,580 fee per container imposed by Juba, leaving essential goods stranded and threatening severe supply chain disruptions for the landlocked nation.

item.title: Advanced Port Community System That is Anticipated to Boost Kenya's Trade
item.description: The global supply chain is increasingly defined by data and digital integration. In a major move to solidify East Africa's place in the digital trade economy, DP World has rolled out its advanced Port Community System (PCS) in Kenya. Focusing on the critical Port of Mombasa, this ambitious project is not just an upgrade; it's a foundational transformation expected to revolutionize the speed, transparency, and efficiency of trade across the entire region.
